title: Verify buf plugin catches invalid kernel imports
description:
Write test proto files that violate kernel import rules and verify `buf lint` with the custom plugin correctly rejects them.

Acceptance criteria: 
- A proto in `coherence/kernel/` importing `coherence/core/` fails.
- A proto in `coherence/kernel/` importing `google/protobuf/` passes.

title: Migrate kernel import check from contracts-tools to buf plugin
description:
Replace the Rust `check` function in `crates/contracts-tools` that validates kernel imports with the new buf plugin config in `buf.yaml`.

The `check-contracts` make target should eventually delegate to `buf lint` with the custom plugin.

title: Add buf plugin install to Makefile
description: Add `install-buf-plugins` target to Makefile that builds and installs all Go plugins from `buf-plugins/`. Update `check` target to depend on it.

title: Add build/install command for buf plugins
description: Add a script or command to build and install buf plugins from `buf-plugins/` to `~/.local/bin/` (or another PATH dir). Should support building all or a specific plugin.

title: Implement kernel imports lint rule + tests
description:
Implement buf check plugin rule that verifies:

- Files under `coherence/kernel/` must only import:
  - `coherence/kernel/\*

Include tests using `bufplugin-go/checktest` with valid/invalid testdata.

title: Create buf plugin project structure
description:
Set up Go module in `buf-plugins/coherence/` with:

- `go.mod`
- `main.go` skeleton
- `rules/` directory
- `testdata/valid/`, `testdata/invalid/`
- `go.mod` with `github.com/bufbuild/bufplugin-go` dependency
